data.description:
Operator-mode enablement, part 2 of 2. Builds on ETCH-47. Full design: docs/ENABLEMENT.md (the spec).

WHAT: 'etch enable' additionally (a) stamps guarded hook entries into .claude/settings.local.json of the repo root and EVERY existing worktree (git worktree list --porcelain; merge politely with existing local settings, byte-preserve foreign entries like install.go does); (b) installs a marker-delimited post-checkout git hook into the EFFECTIVE hooks dir (honor core.hooksPath) that stamps any new worktree at creation — idempotent, fast-exits when already stamped, chains politely with pre-existing post-checkout content; (c) 'disable' best-effort removes stamps + the post-checkout block.

DEDUPE (ships in this ticket, not later): stamped commands embed the committed-entries-win guard — if grep -qs entire-agent-etch .claude/settings.json then exit 0 — so a branch that merges committed hooks never double-captures. Exact command shape is in ENABLEMENT.md.

ALSO: extend etch doctor scope (ETCH-46) with checks: config key state, per-worktree stamp coverage, hooksPath mismatch. Update README + docs/HOOK_CONTRACT.md cross-refs; the platform doc (code/platform/etch.md, separate repo) Worktrees section should be updated by the implementer to drop the interim-recipe framing once this ships.

ACCEPTANCE (edge cases enumerated in ENABLEMENT.md): (1) worktree created AFTER enable captures with zero manual steps — the headline test; (2) worktree whose branch merges main's committed hooks → exactly one capture per event; (3) repo with custom core.hooksPath → propagation works or doctor flags it; (4) install-hooks (team mode) on an operator-mode repo → no double capture; (5) tests via testutil temp repos with real git worktree add.
data.title: etch enable: worktree stamping + post-checkout self-propagation + dedupe

data.body: VALIDATION EVIDENCE (live c11 pilot, 2026-06-12): (1) binary reinstalled to ~/.local/bin from merged main; (2) 'entire-agent-etch enable' in code/c11 — etch.enabled=true, 2/13 worktrees newly stamped (main checkout incl. foreign permissions preserved semantically-identical), the 11 interim hand-stamps detected idempotently (byte-untouched, exactly 1 entry/event), post-checkout installed, managed exclude block written (interim hand-added lines removed); (3) HEADLINE: 'git worktree add' of a throwaway → auto-stamped with zero manual steps (5 events, guard present); real headless session in it (env -u CLAUDECODE claude -p 'say ok' --dangerously-skip-permissions) → refs/etch/sessions went 3→4, exactly ONE new ref (the branch also carries committed hooks — dedupe held live), session.json = etch.session.v1, status complete, is_worktree true, correct worktree_path, prompt captured; throwaway removed cleanly. Plus the full unit-level evidence: suite green -count=1 locally and on CI (runs 27435169214, 27436281384).

Shipped operator-mode enablement part 2 (PR #3 squash-merged as dd7dcc3; review-fixes follow-up PR #4 as fdf6b7e). 'etch enable' now stamps guarded hook entries into .claude/settings.local.json of the main checkout and every existing worktree (best-effort: pruned paths skipped with warnings; foreign settings preserved via install.go's merge engine, refactored into exported InstallEntries/RemoveEntries with a pluggable command builder — team mode untouched) and installs a marker-delimited post-checkout block into the effective hooks dir (honors core.hooksPath; chains politely with sh-family hooks; warns and skips non-shell/binary hooks with an honest summary line; repairs missing exec bits). New stamp-worktree subcommand (quiet, idempotent, requires etch.enabled explicitly true) gives every future worktree a stamp at birth. Dedupe ships inside the stamp (committed entries win via grep guard), byte-identical to the 2026-06-12 c11 hand-stamps so enable upgraded them idempotently in the field. 'disable' best-effort removes stamps + the hook block. Docs: README operator mode, HOOK_CONTRACT second-dispatch-source + limitations (incl. grep-guard any-mention edge), ENABLEMENT interim section closed, ROLLOUT ✅ note, platform etch.md Worktrees rewritten (Forgejo commit b0e0081), ETCH-46 ticket extended with doctor checks. Plan-review PASS (major + 4 minors folded in pre-PR); code-review PASS (6 minors folded in via PR #4). All six ENABLEMENT edge cases tested with real git worktree add; live validation on c11: new worktree auto-stamped, real headless session captured exactly one ref in the shared store.
